criteria.evidence: Section 1 logs query, retrieved chunks, and final answer, and maps symptoms to failing boundaries (retrieval, generation, no abstention path). Context construction is covered via 'Reduce context noise', delimiting, and top-k selection, though it is not a separate labeled boundary.
criteria.criterion: Trace retrieval, context construction, and generation boundaries.

criteria.evidence: 'Don't change anything until you know which bucket most failures fall into'; builds an eval set of 30-50 questions first; 'Don't add a new framework... before you've done the diagnosis'; changes are verified against metrics.

It separates retrieval from generation by classifying failures, and says to change one thing at a time and rerun the eval set. It never proposes an explicit isolation experiment, such as feeding gold passages directly to the generator to bypass retrieval, or testing retrieval alone.
criteria.criterion: Use an isolation experiment where appropriate.
